name: setup-manaflow-ai-aurora-look
description: A whole cmux look built only from public surfaces: a theme file that turns on the Mac's own glass for the window and gives light and dark their own snow and polar-night colors, settings for type and the sidebar's group colors, a stylesheet of cmux.agentPane.style/1 tokens for the prompt bubble and cards, and a customize view whose hover card puts its status on chip glass. Remove it and everything you had comes back.

files.customize/cmux-app.json:
{
  "$schema": "https://cmux.dev/schemas/cmux-app/2.json",
  "manifestVersion": 2,
  "id": "local/customize",
  "name": { "en": "Aurora hover card" },
  "version": "1.0.0",
  "description": "Aurora's hover card: the title, its status on a small chip of the app's glass, what the agent is doing, and where.",
  "engines": { "cmux": "^2.0" },
  "repository": "https://github.com/local/customize",
  "runtime": { "main": "main.js" },
  "implements": {
    "cmux.hovercard/1": { "export": "renderCard" }
  },
  "scopes": { "workspace:read": "Read the hovered workspace's card." },
  "activation": ["onInterface:cmux.hovercard/1"],
  "files": ["main.js"]
}
files.themes/aurora.json:
// Aurora: clear glass over your own desktop, polar-night and snow colors, and a teal-to-violet
// accent used in a few places only. The chrome (titlebar, tab strip, sidebar) is the window's own
// glass; the chat is the content layer, nearly solid so it reads over any wallpaper. Light and dark
// both come from this one file: `appearance.theme` names a light and a dark terminal theme and
// `appearance.themeEdits` gives each its own colors, so the look follows the Mac's appearance.
{
  "name": "Aurora",
  "description": "Clear glass chrome over your desktop, snow and polar-night colors, a teal-to-violet accent.",

  // Light and dark: one terminal theme for each, with Aurora's own colors.
  "appearance.theme": "light:Builtin Light,dark:Builtin Dark",
  // cmux's own window, sidebar and pages follow the terminal theme, not the person's App Theme.
  "appearance.appTheme": "followTerminal",
  "appearance.themeEdits": {
    // Polar night: a blue-black sky, starlight text, the aurora's green-teal as the accent and
    // its violet upper edge as the cursor.
    "Builtin Dark/background": "#0a0f1c",
    "Builtin Dark/foreground": "#e7ecf4",
    "Builtin Dark/cursor": "#c4b5fd",
    "Builtin Dark/selection": "#657592",
    "Builtin Dark/accent": "#5eead4",
    "Builtin Dark/0": "#1b2333",
    "Builtin Dark/1": "#f87171",
    "Builtin Dark/2": "#4ade80",
    "Builtin Dark/3": "#facc15",
    "Builtin Dark/4": "#60a5fa",
    "Builtin Dark/5": "#c4b5fd",
    "Builtin Dark/6": "#5eead4",
    "Builtin Dark/7": "#cbd5e1",
    "Builtin Dark/8": "#7d8ba3",
    "Builtin Dark/9": "#fca5a5",
    "Builtin Dark/10": "#86efac",
    "Builtin Dark/11": "#fde68a",
    "Builtin Dark/12": "#93c5fd",
    "Builtin Dark/13": "#ddd6fe",
    "Builtin Dark/14": "#99f6e4",
    "Builtin Dark/15": "#f8fafc",
    // Snow: a cool off-white, ink text, a deep glacier teal that still reads as a mark on the
    // clearest glass over a black desktop, and a deep violet cursor.
    "Builtin Light/background": "#f4f7fb",
    "Builtin Light/foreground": "#161d2b",
    "Builtin Light/cursor": "#6d28d9",
    "Builtin Light/selection": "#cfe0f2",
    "Builtin Light/accent": "#0b5d55",
    "Builtin Light/0": "#161d2b",
    "Builtin Light/1": "#b42318",
    "Builtin Light/2": "#13743a",
    "Builtin Light/3": "#8a5a00",
    "Builtin Light/4": "#1d4ed8",
    "Builtin Light/5": "#6d28d9",
    "Builtin Light/6": "#0d7268",
    "Builtin Light/7": "#4b5565",
    "Builtin Light/8": "#5b6576",
    "Builtin Light/9": "#c22a1f",
    "Builtin Light/10": "#106b35",
    "Builtin Light/11": "#7a4f00",
    "Builtin Light/12": "#1e40af",
    "Builtin Light/13": "#5b21b6",
    "Builtin Light/14": "#0b5f57",
    "Builtin Light/15": "#f4f7fb"
  },
  "appearance.accent": "theme",

  // The window: no painting, the Mac's own glass over your desktop, tinted 72% with the theme's
  // background and leaning toward the desktop picture's hue. Under Reduce Transparency the app
  // paints the theme background opaque instead.
  "appearance.background": "none",
  "appearance.backgroundBlur": "glass",
  "appearance.backgroundOpacity": 0.72,
  "appearance.glassTransparency": 0,
  "appearance.wallpaperTint": true,

  // Chrome is glass, content is solid: the sidebar and the tab strip are the window's glass (no
  // override), the chat covers 90% so text reads on the worst backdrop.
  "appearance.chromeStyle": "flat",
  "appearance.sidebarSurface": "same",
  "appearance.surfaces.agentPane.opacity": 0.9,
  "sidebar.sectionLook": "quiet",

  // The address bar's glass takes a faint accent tint.
  "browser.omnibar.glassTint": "accent",
  "browser.omnibar.glassTintStrength": 0.12,

  "appearance.statusIndicator.style": "arc",
  "appearance.density": "comfortable"
}
